post.caption: Princess Margaret's engagement was announced on February 26, 1960, and her fiance, the society photographer Antony Armstrong Jones, designed the ring himself. A ruby sits at the center, circled by diamond petals like a rosebud. They married at Westminster Abbey on May 6, 1960, in the first royal wedding shown on television. Her granddaughter Lady Margarita owns the ring today.
